note: Both sets read values off the plots and both contain unit/scale errors (e.g., stiffness values dropped from the 1e11 axis multiplier, and N.m^-2 typos), but Set A binds more facts to the right properties: root mass density, root edge/torsional/axial stiffness, and the chordwise ranges of the shear and neutral centers in Figure 2-11. Set B invents or misbinds several claims, notably two 'chord length' values (-2.6 m, 2.5 m) that are actually planform edge positions, a shear-center position of -4.0 m at r/R=0.3 (that is the lower planform edge, the shear center sits near 0), and mass density 0 at the tip. Set A also has defects — a conflicting duplicate mass-density pair (3100 vs 3000), a wrong-unit torsional duplicate, unscaled edge/torsional values, an r/B 'series: green' claim, and mass density 0 at r/B=1.0 — but its error count is lower and its correct coverage is higher.
